meta.purpose: Real, externally-sourced tactical enrichment layer for Tactical Lab. Replaces the arbitrary v48 payload. Every numeric value, statement, and tactical principle below is attached to a source object. Some qualitative fields (style pairs, lane descriptions) are intentionally left as `unverified` so the app can fall back to v20/v48 values there in a controlled way without re-using fabricated metrics.
meta.compilation_philosophy: We only ship numbers we could read on a public URL. Direct quotes are reproduced verbatim from the cited conference/article. If we could not verify a value, we marked it unverified rather than guess.
